usageNotes: Use this to confirm which storage plugin type backs a named storage and retrieve its internal identifier, which is plugin-dependent (e.g., a pool name for ZFS/LVM, a share path for NFS/CIFS). Requires either Datastore.Audit or Datastore.AllocateSpace on the /storage/{storage} ACL path. The target node must be online and have the storage mounted/accessible.

examples.summary: Get identity info for an NFS storage on pve1

tips: The 'id' field format varies by plugin: ZFS returns the pool/dataset name, LVM returns the VG name, PBS returns the datastore name, NFS/CIFS return the share path.
Use this endpoint to validate that a storage ID maps to the expected backend before automating provisioning or backup jobs against it.
If the storage is not available on the specified node, the API will return an error even if it is defined cluster-wide — check node-specific storage availability first.
